# Slope gives acceleration

<!-- STEP id="rising" -->
On the rising line, from 10 s to 20 s, the velocity goes from 5 m/s to 10 m/s.

a = BC / CA = 5 m/s / 10 s = 0.5 m/s².

<!-- STEP id="falling" -->
On the falling line, from 10 s to 20 s, the velocity goes from 10 m/s to 5 m/s. a = -5 m/s / 10 s = -0.5 m/s², opposite to the velocity.

**The slope of a velocity-time graph gives the acceleration.**
